/*
 * wow64_automarshal.c — GENERATED by tools/wow64gen/marshalgen.py. DO NOT EDIT.
 *
 * 32->64 syscall thunks that wow64gen (stage 1) could not derive from the
 * .spec alone: flat thunks recovered from real header prototypes, and
 * field-copy deep marshallers generated from clang record-layout diffs
 * (i686 vs aarch64) through the real header stack.
 *
 * Regenerate:  python3 tools/wow64gen/marshalgen.py gen
 * (requires configured build-arm64/ + build-i386/ for compile_commands.json)
 */

#include <stdarg.h>
#define WIN32_NO_STATUS
#include <windef.h>
#include <winnt.h>
#include <ndk/ntndk.h>

#include "wow64_status.h"

static void WowAmCpy(unsigned char *d, const unsigned char *s, unsigned n)
{
    while (n--) *d++ = *s++;
}

static void WowAmZero(unsigned char *d, unsigned n)
{
    while (n--) *d++ = 0;
}

/* 4 -> 8 sign-extend (covers pointers/handles: guest VAs < 2GB, and
 * pseudo-handles (-1, -2) which are only correct sign-extended) */
static void WowAmSx(unsigned char *d, const unsigned char *s)
{
    LONG v;
    LONGLONG w;
    WowAmCpy((unsigned char *)&v, s, 4);
    w = (LONGLONG)v;
    WowAmCpy(d, (const unsigned char *)&w, 8);
}

/* 8 -> 4 narrow */
static void WowAmNx(unsigned char *d, const unsigned char *s)
{
    WowAmCpy(d, s, 4);
}

/* A leading self-describing size ("cbSize"): the guest states ITS sizeof and
 * the callee compares against the HOST's, so a verbatim copy fails the very
 * version check the field exists for. Rewrite it — but ONLY when it is
 * exactly the 32-bit sizeof, so a struct with more than one legal size
 * (MONITORINFO vs MONITORINFOEXW) still reaches the kernel with the size the
 * guest actually chose, and a garbage value still gets rejected as garbage. */
static void WowAmSizeIn(unsigned char *d, const unsigned char *s,
                        ULONG g32, ULONG h64)
{
    ULONG v;
    WowAmCpy((unsigned char *)&v, s, 4);
    if (v == g32) v = h64;
    WowAmCpy(d, (const unsigned char *)&v, 4);
}

/* ...and undo it on the way back: the kernel restamps cbSize with the host
 * sizeof, which would leave the guest holding a size that does not describe
 * its own struct. */
static void WowAmSizeOut(unsigned char *d, const unsigned char *s,
                         ULONG g32, ULONG h64)
{
    ULONG v;
    WowAmCpy((unsigned char *)&v, s, 4);
    if (v == h64) v = g32;
    WowAmCpy(d, (const unsigned char *)&v, 4);
}

static int WowAmStrEq(const char *a, const char *b)
{
    while (*a && *a == *b) { a++; b++; }
    return *a == *b;
}

/* struct _INNER: 8 -> 16 bytes */
static void WowAmIn__INNER(const unsigned char *s, unsigned char *d)
{
    WowAmZero(d, 16);
    WowAmCpy(d + 0, s + 0, 4); /* count */
    WowAmSx(d + 8, s + 4); /* hwnd */
}

static void WowAmOut__INNER(const unsigned char *s, unsigned char *d)
{
    WowAmCpy(d + 0, s + 0, 4); /* count */
    WowAmNx(d + 4, s + 8); /* hwnd */
}
/* struct _OUTER: 16 -> 32 bytes */
static void WowAmIn__OUTER(const unsigned char *s, unsigned char *d)
{
    WowAmZero(d, 32);
    WowAmSizeIn(d + 0, s + 0, 16, 32); /* cbSize */
    WowAmIn__INNER(s + 4, d + 8); /* inner */
    WowAmCpy(d + 24, s + 12, 4); /* bytes */
}

static void WowAmOut__OUTER(const unsigned char *s, unsigned char *d)
{
    WowAmSizeOut(d + 0, s + 0, 16, 32); /* cbSize */
    WowAmOut__INNER(s + 8, d + 4); /* inner */
    WowAmCpy(d + 12, s + 24, 4); /* bytes */
}

static NTSTATUS WowAmThunk_NtWiden(ULONG *a)
{
    extern ULONGLONG NtWiden(ULONGLONG, ULONGLONG);
    unsigned char b0[32] __attribute__((aligned(16)));
    const unsigned char *g0 = (const unsigned char *)(ULONG_PTR)a[0];
    ULONGLONG r;
    (void)a;
    if (g0) WowAmIn__OUTER(g0, b0);
    r = NtWiden((g0 ? (ULONGLONG)(ULONG_PTR)b0 : 0), (ULONGLONG)(LONGLONG)(LONG)a[1]);
    if (g0) WowAmOut__OUTER(b0, (unsigned char *)(ULONG_PTR)a[0]);
    return (NTSTATUS)(ULONG)r;
}
static NTSTATUS WowAmThunk_NtFlat(ULONG *a)
{
    extern ULONGLONG NtFlat(ULONGLONG, ULONGLONG);
    ULONGLONG r;
    (void)a;
    r = NtFlat((ULONGLONG)(LONGLONG)(LONG)a[0], ((ULONGLONG)a[1] | ((ULONGLONG)a[2] << 32)));
    return (NTSTATUS)(ULONG)r;
}

NTSTATUS Wow64AutoMarshalDispatch(const char *Name, ULONG *Arguments)
{
    if (WowAmStrEq(Name, "NtWiden"))
        return WowAmThunk_NtWiden(Arguments);
    if (WowAmStrEq(Name, "NtFlat"))
        return WowAmThunk_NtFlat(Arguments);
    return WOW64_AUTOMARSHAL_UNIMPL;
}

 *   NtDeep: _DEEP not generatable (deep pointee)
 *   NtMissing: no prototype
 *   NtSemantic: param x is SEMANTIC
 *   NtUnlinked: not exported by exports-input.txt
